mapper.select: SELECT f.fair_id , f.name AS fair_name , f.status AS fair_status , f.published_at , f.canceled_at , f.pet_allowed , fd.fair_date_id , fd.operation_date , fd.entry_start_time , fd.entry_end_time , osp.price AS onsite_price , osp.status AS onsite_sales_status FROM fairs f JOIN fair_dates fd ON fd.fair_id = f.fair_id LEFT JOIN onsite_sales_policies osp ON osp.fair_date_id = fd.fair_date_id WHERE f.fair_id = #{fairId} AND fd.operation_date = #{operationDate} FOR UPDATE OF fd, osp
SELECT fair_date_id , fair_id , operation_date FROM fair_dates WHERE fair_id = #{fairId} AND fair_date_id = #{fairDateId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT onsite_sales_policy_id , fair_date_id , price , capacity , reserved_count , status , updated_by , version , created_at , updated_at FROM onsite_sales_policies WHERE fair_date_id = #{fairDateId}
